title: The Rev. Duke Yonge
dates: (3 Dec 1750-3 Dec 1823)
---

Vicar of Cornwood, paternal grandfather of CMY.

He served as Vicar of Cornwood 1793-1811.

He married (12 Mar 1777) Catherine, sister of Sir Thomas Crawley-Boevey.
